reviews.text: Very disappointed. Actually  blamed me for my puppies behavior.  Expensive and not professional at all. Much better places available to take your dogs. Stay away from this place.

'Renee and Sabira are wonderful trainers.  They've worked with puppies that I've had in the past, and were helped to  make them into totally great little dogs.  They're now helping to train our newest puppy, Archie.  Renee and Sabira show true compassion with the dogs they train, with kindness, patience and loving care.  They're the greatest!
I highly recommend the agility classes! Our instructor is Sabira, and we are so happy with her.

I couldn’t recommend this more. Sabira is so kind and truly cares about your dogs. We brought my pup for a swim for his first birthday and she opened it just for us!! Please everyone go here we couldn’t get our dog out of the pool he loved it so much

All About Dogs has been a fantastic experience for both us and our dog. We began with basic obedience and later joined agility classes, and the progress has been amazing. The trainers are friendly, knowledgeable, and truly care. The atmosphere is welcoming, fun, and motivating. We genuinely look forward to every visit and highly recommend them.
Excellent dog training and agility facility with multiple programs for all levels. Provides much needed enrichment for our spaniel mix who loves it here.

I have worked with many different dog training facilities All About Dogs shines out for being one of the best in Toronto.The facility is spacious and well maintained. Renee is very knowledgeable and makes the training sessions fun. Renee has a wonderful way of teaching you to work with dog so that both are learning new skills and having fun.

We, especially our dog, absolutely love coming to All About Dogs. We started with basic obedience training and have since moved up into agility classes with Renee, and it has been such a rewarding experience. The instructors are friendly, the environment is welcoming, and every class has been a lot of fun. We look forward to coming every week to practice agility, and it’s been amazing to see how much our dog has grown, matured, and enjoyed herself through the process. We’ve also grown as trainers, and it’s been an overall wonderful experience. Highly recommend!

I highly recommend All About Dogs for anyone who is considering agility. Agility has been one of the best confidence-building activities for our Mini Aussie- who can be described as a nervous dog with big emotions! Renee is an A+ coach who can understand & adapt to the dog's needs quickly- she is dedicated to ensuring you get results. While agility has been amazing for our dog we have also had huge strides in increasing our skills in communicating clearly with our dog.  Give it a shot you won't be disappointed!

Rene and the team at All About Dogs are so patient and knowledgeable. From intro to more advanced classes, it's so much fun to learn how to handle and to see how quickly your dog advances. Great bonding too. Best in show!
Great dog training facility and trainers!!
Brittany did a great job grooming our dog today. Not only is the cut professional, she has a way of making our dog comfortable during the entire process.

We had an amazing experience at this training facility with our puppy, Zaria! We took 3 different classes, and they were incredibly helpful in building Zaria’s confidence and mine with training and teaching us valuable skills. Sabira was wonderful — she made me feel comfortable throughout the training and was always ready to answer any questions I had, providing helpful guidance to improve our sessions. The facility itself is top-notch: clean, welcoming, and we loved that they have a pool. Highly recommend it for anyone looking to build a strong connection and foundation with their puppy!

Fantastic Dog Agility Classes!"

I can’t say enough great things about the dog agility classes! My dog and I have been attending several courses already, and the progress we've made is truly amazing. The trainers are incredibly knowledgeable, nice, patient, and passionate about their work. They’ve created a positive and supportive environment where dogs and owners can thrive.

The classes are structured and well-paced, making them enjoyable for dogs of all levels, from beginners to more advanced. My dog has become more focused, confident, and excited to learn, and I’ve learned so much about training techniques and how to build a stronger bond with my pet. The various obstacles and exercises keep things fun and engaging, and the trainers always offer personalized guidance to ensure we’re progressing comfortably.

The facility is amazing. It is ultra-clean, has proper-sized equipment, and is so well organized that there is space for every dog and their needs.

I would highly recommend all the agility classes to anyone looking to improve their dog’s confidence, focus, and agility skills. It’s been such a rewarding experience for both me and my dog!

Anywhere but here is my best advice for you and your pup. The instructors give off a negative and judgey vibe. This makes going to classes grating and unenjoyable. Tons of better options in Toronto. Keep looking.

I went a few months ago for a puppy swimming introduction and had a terrible experience. At first I wasn’t going to leave a review but since I can’t get it off my mind this long after, I’ve decided I need to for my own mental health.

I had just recently adopted my first puppy who at the time was about 5 months old. He’s a high energy dog and I was told his mom loves swimming so I thought it would be a great activity for him.

For background, I’ve done puppy classes with him and also have a private trainer who I do sessions with. He was (and is) a very good puppy. At the time, he was very excitable around new people and at new places. Multiple trainers had told me that since he was a baby he just needs to explore, be socialized, and continue training as we’d been doing. (He indeed has calmed down a lot in the past few months).

I went to All About Dogs only for the swimming session, as he had never been in a pool before.

The swim instructor immediately began commenting on his behaviour when she saw him pull at the leash to check out and sniff the area, saying he was very bad, laughing and saying things like “wow someone sure needs training”. When I mentioned we did do training she then started making comments that it must not be very good training.

During the session she continued to make jabs and I was extremely uncomfortable. My own anxiety disorder started to take over and I had a difficult time trying to combat what she was saying, eventually I shut down and just stopped talking for the rest of the time.

She did things like try to grab toys out of his mouth then say he needs to learn how to let go. At the time he had already learned the “drop it” command very well. He’s used to playing tug which is one of his favourite games so he automatically tugs back until told to drop the toy which he always does. She didn’t bother to ask about his commands and just kept pulling on toys that were in his mouth until she overpowered him to get them.

She continued to say his training was terrible and comment that she could do better with him for the entire session and afterwards, while I was trying to gather my things and leave (as quickly as possible since I was on the verge of having a panic attack).

I’ve never experienced something like this before, where I paid money to be attacked and bullied. This one short session really mentally affected how free I felt to enjoy socializing and training my dog in public. Months later, even though his obedience has been great, I still get stressed that someone will try to ridicule me if he’s not robot level perfect.

I’m writing this to get it off my chest and to let anyone reading know that your journey with your dog should not be judged. Work together and build your relationship. Don’t let others make you feel like you’re not good enough.

Honestly, this is the most amazingly entertaining experience with our lab, Prince that we have ever had.  The facility is absolutely human and dog-friendly.  The trainer is phenomenally professional, courteous, kind, gentle, and knowledgeable.  Prince had the time of his life.  Prince was reluctant at first to venture into the pool but with the gentle and kind coaxing he took to the pool like a seal.  He had the most fun that I have ever seen him have.  What an incredible experience for us.  It's one on one coaching and training  with the doggy parent(s) present throughout the entire process.  This is our first time but definitely will not be our last time.  Well worth the very reasonable price.  Lots of free parking.  Conveniently located.  Clean and beautifully maintained premises.  All indoor facility.  Remember to bring your poolside footwear, and a big towel for your pallie, and maybe a smaller towel for yourself.  I rate "All About Dogs" 5 out of 5 mustaches.  And Prince rates it 5 out of 5 waggy tails.  There you have it.  A perfect score for "All About Dogs" and their wonder trainer.  Uncle Carmine knows a great time.

Want to make your dog smile?
Sign them up for Agility at All About Dogs!
Agility days are the favorite days in our house, the second the agility bag comes out, my dog is happily dancing around me and smiles all the way to the arena.
The facility is outstanding: clean, warm and bright, with plenty of space and professional equipment. The special flooring makes it extra comfy and safe for both dogs and people.
The instructor, Renee, is extremely knowledgeable and always has spot on suggestions to improve the teamwork between you and your dog.
Al About Dogs is truly that: It is all about YOUR dog and to bring out the best in them. You can feel the love for dogs, all shapes, sizes and personalities, in every interaction. My dog has developed from a shy and timid beginner to a confident star on the course!
And a tired, relaxed and content dog at the end of the day is a nice extra bonus 😊
Thank you, Renee and team!

The very best!!! I have worked with dogs in a professional training setting/capacity for over 20 years and in multiple cities. All About Dogs is easily the best training facility and program I have ever been a part of. The facility itself is stunning (hello, no pee smell!!) and Renee and her team just *get* dogs on a whole new level. She makes agility fun for the humans and the dogs, super understanding and knows exactly what to do to help dogs and their handlers perform at their best.

My dog and I have been taking the agility classes for the past 2 months and it’s been a great experience! Renee and Sabira teach foundations and doesn’t rush the process to make sure it’s a positive experience for my dog. I’m so proud how far my dog is getting at agility training.

We took our young Samoyed dog to Beginner Agility Class (levels 1 and 2).

Renee made the classes very engaging, gave amazing tips on agility handling and helped us understand how our body language may send our dog in the wrong direction (it turns out, we had a big disconnect between our verbal and body language cues, which confused our dog). Our dog has always enjoyed training and being active, and she loves coming to All About Dogs for agility classes.

The pros of this agility program:
- spending a considerable amount of time working on foundation skills
- building the human/animal bond and strengthening engagement
- learning to communicate clearly with the dog and developing skills that can be applicable in day to day life
- classes are inclusive, and reactive dogs are allowed to participate. Renee helps manage them very well so that everyone can train safely
- Renee is very good at coaching handlers. She is so experienced in this sport that she can quickly spot the mistakes and help break down all exercises into smaller steps
- everybody gets enough time to practice and enough time with the trainer
- the facility is large and very clean
- Renee makes dog owners feel more confident handling their dogs. We always left the class feeling like our dog is a genius and looking forward to more training the following week
I took the beginner puppy class here and the instructor was rude. Every class the Instructor had negative comments about my puppy. Don't go here if you want to be treated with respect.

This is a wonderful dog training facility with excellent caring instructors. We have done obedience training classes with good success and now we are taking their agility classes and we are really enjoying the well structured sessions.
Thanks Daniela!
